text:
arjun: FYI EU1 dedicated pool showing p99 token latency spike and occasional gpipe errors after last kernel roll (6.3.8). Noticed increase ~09:10 UTC.

kate: saw the alerts. is it sustained or microbursts?

arjun: p50 stable, p95 creeping, p99 jumps in 200-400ms spikes every ~30s for some tenants. logs show network retransmits + some kworker CPU.

sam: @arjun do we have a recent nv_peer_to_peer or pcie error in node logs?

arjun: quick grep: ``grep -iE "pcie|gpipe|dma" /var/log/syslog | tail -n 50`` -> some DMA timeouts on a subset of hosts. also kernel change touched iommu path.

infra-bot: deploy-bot rolled out kernel/6.3.8 to eu1-rack-3 at 08:55 UTC (canary=5 nodes).

maria: can we soft-fallback routing away from affected racks for latency-sensitive routes? thinking: prefer hotlane on eu1-rack-1/2, soften weights for rack-3. cost vs SLA tradeoff though.

sam: yes, we can add a short-term routing policy toggle. propose:
```
route-policy:
  prefer_racks: [eu1-rack-1, eu1-rack-2]
  deprioritize: [eu1-rack-3]
  duration: 15m
  reason: kernel-6.3.8-dma-timeouts
```
apply to service tag=prod-high-latency-slo

kate: +1. also enable kv-cache warm-up on fallback model to avoid cold p50 blips. small extra mem cost but helps latency.

arjun: doing a quick probe: isolating three nodes from pool-42 and running stress repro. if repro confirmed we'll rollback kernel and requeue canary.

maria: if we fallback to other racks, we increase cross-az egress. cost estimate?

sam: rough calc: if 5% of traffic shifts cross-az for 2h, additional egress ~$1200 for eu1. we can cap to 2k tokens/s to limit spend.

arjun: experiment plan: 1) apply routing policy (15m) 2) enable kv warm-up 3) cap token rate on fallback 4) run repro on isolated nodes 5) rollback kernel if repro reproduces.

kate: who can own the routing toggle and rollback?

maria: i'll own routing toggle and cost cap.

arjun: i'll handle repro and kernel rollback if needed. sam can monitor telemetry and update dashboard.

deploy-bot: rollback job queued: kernel/6.3.7 -> eu1-rack-3 (requires manual approve).

sam: monitoring: adding a temporary p99 per-tenant dashboard and an egress spend alert. will post snapshots in 10m. :mag:
